name: block_sidewall_tap
description: Block with an M8 tapped bore into a vertical SIDEWALL — the placement that forced freehand normal maths (Pos*Rot*tap on a -X face).

stages.prompt:
Steel cube 40 x 40 x 40, parametric, mm units, resting on the XY plane, centred in X and Y.
- One M8 tapped (internal thread, M8x1.25) blind bore, 20 mm deep, into the LEFT side face (the -X face), centred on that face (y=0, z=20), bore axis along X, opening normal to the wall.
No other features.
